@graph.name: Do I need a GrubMarket AI alternative so customers can speak their own orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. GrubAssist can keep serving your team while VoiceOrder Solutions gives each account its own voice app: speak, check, send. Nothing on your side has to be switched off or retrained.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions a GrubMarket AI competitor, since both use voice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Less than it looks. GrubAssist, going by their own site, works for your team: ask it about the business, have it write up an order. Ours is for your customers, who speak and approve their own orders, so your staff never write up anything placed in our app. That is why a team looking at a GrubMarket AI alternative to get voice orders can simply run both.

@graph.name: Can your app tell us how a customer is performing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Our admin screen shows what each account has ordered and lets you manage accounts and guides. GrubAssist advertises reporting on how accounts perform and we do not, which is a good reason to keep it.

@graph.name: Is there any link between GrubAssist and your app?

acceptedAnswer.text: None. Nothing links the two, and neither company supports the other. GrubAssist connects to your ERP so it can answer questions about the business; we only ever deliver approved orders into your system, in the formats listed further up.

@graph.name: Do we have to teach your app our catalog?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There is nothing to teach, so there is no training tool for it. The item list you keep for an account is all the setup it needs. GrubMarket AI offers an AI training module for its assistant, and that stays theirs to run.

@graph.name: How soon could our accounts be ordering?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most distributors this is live inside 24 to 48 hours, and customers usually place a first order the day they get their login. GrubAssist carries on as before while it happens. Accounts that keep calling still can; a call just gets no order number or timestamp from us.

@graph.name: How is voice for customers priced next to GrubAssist?

acceptedAnswer.text: Neither of us publishes a figure. Ours arrives as a quote once we know your setup; theirs comes after a demo. Keeping GrubAssist means the only cost to weigh is the voice app for your customers.

@graph.name: Where do the GrubMarket details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Taken from grubmarket.ai on 10 October 2026, which is the GrubMarket AI product rather than GrubMarket the company: the GrubAssist description, the list of advertised jobs, the training module and the other products all come off that page. They publish no price and no rollout time, so this page does not guess at either. If any of it has changed since, the mistake is ours to fix.
